title: Labelling
subtitle: People label agent answers or judge decisions. Agreeing labels resolve an item and become calibration labels for the benchmark's judge.
empty: No labelling queues yet. Create one, then add the runs of an evaluation to label.
fromCalibration: Have several people label answers, with agreement measured, in a labelling queue.
viewerNote: Your role can read labelling queues but not label or change them.

create.title: New queue
create.description: A queue holds the answers people label, how many people label each one, and what they may see.
create.name: Name
create.benchmarkNone: None (keep labels in the queue only)
create.benchmarkHint: Resolved labels go to this benchmark's judge calibration.
create.kindRuns: Agent answers: is the answer correct?
create.kindJudge: Judge decisions: was the judge right?
create.reviewersHint: With 2 or more, agreement (kappa) is measured and disagreements wait for a decision.
create.blind: Blind: hide the agent, version and run from labellers
create.assignmentOpen: Anyone in the organization takes the next item
create.assignmentFixed: Only the people each item is assigned to
